content.bridge_context: We learn to represent our physical world on paper using maps, symbols, and directions.

units.title: Cardinal Directions
units.explanation: The four main directions are North, South, East, and West. On a map, North is usually at the top.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the directions. / दिशाओं की पहचान करें।

units.title: Map Symbols and Scale
units.explanation: Symbols represent real things (like trees or houses), and Scale shows how much the map is smaller than the real world.
units.dual_language_instruction: Read the map legend. / मानचित्र के संकेतों को पढ़ें।
